race.comment: TOTALLY STUNNING (7) is in good form with top-five finishes at her last four starts, most recently recording a third over 1740m at Riverina Paceway. Has to contend with a very wide draw. Has the class to trouble this line-up. LEONARD (6) is worth another chance after a last-start seventh over 2190m at Shepparton two weeks ago. HUNGRY HOGARTH (3) has each-way claims after finishing after finishing runner-up over 1750m at Swan Hill last time out. YOUVE BEEN SERVED (4) is better than her last start run would suggest and is worth including in exotic bets.
